name: CERN
body: security.txt, a sitemap in robots.txt, and pages that name their language. But none of the 20 pages analyzed has a meta description, the home page included, so search engines pick the snippet.
lesson: Start with the home page and your ten most visited: one sentence each on what the reader will find.
summary: home.cern scores 66 out of 100 (D). 4 checks fail now, 27 are at risk, and 15 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on 11 of 12 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: Other sites can frame the page
fix.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors was sent, so the page can be framed for clickjacking. Missing on 11 of 12 pages analyzed.
fix.fix: Send Content-Security-Policy: frame-ancestors 'self' (and X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN for old browsers).

fix.title: 1 cookie is sent without Secure, and 1 session cookie is readable by scripts
fix.evidence: Without Secure: keycloak-instance. Without HttpOnly: KC_AUTH_SESSION_HASH. A script injected into the page could steal the session. Set on…
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: 52 scripts block the first paint
fix.evidence: They sit in <head> without async or defer.
fix.fix: Add defer to scripts that do not need to run before the page shows.

fix.title: 12 pages have no meta description
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: No content security policy
fix.evidence: content-security-policy was absent on the start page. Missing on 11 of 12 pages analyzed. Injected scripts are not limited by the browser.
fix.fix: Start with the Report-Only policy in the fix kit, watch the reports for a week, then enforce it.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
The TLS certificate is valid for 36 more days
Every image has an alt attribute
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Language alternates point at each other
